Chronicles

KRON-ih-kulz — contains 'chrono,' meaning time; chronicles march through events in time order. · noun

Hear It

What It Means

Chronicles is a factual record of events arranged in the order they happened.

The explorer's chronicles of the expedition described each day's discoveries in careful detail.

Worked Example

A ship's captain writes in a logbook every single day of a long voyage, noting the weather, the crew's health, and each island they pass, in the exact order everything occurred.

A day-by-day, factual account of events in the order they happened is exactly what chronicles are. Unlike 'legend,' which may be exaggerated or invented, chronicles are meant to be a truthful, ordered record.

How Chronicles Sits Among Its Neighbors

Synonyms — open each to see how it differs

annals

annals: a historical record of events year by year

records

records: documented accounts of events or facts

accounts

accounts: descriptions or reports of events

Antonyms

rumors

rumors: unverified stories passed by word of mouth

fiction

fiction: invented stories not based on fact

How Strong Is It? — notes → chronicles → archive

notes vs. chronicles

notes vs. chronicles: Notes are weaker than chronicles — notes are brief, informal jottings, while chronicles are a complete, ordered historical record.

archive vs. chronicles

archive vs. chronicles: An archive can be stronger than chronicles: chronicles are an ordered written record of events, but an archive is an entire organized collection of original documents, records, and evidence.

Build the Word

The pieces

root — chron-

root — chron-: time (Greek)

suffix — -icle(s)

suffix — -icle(s): relating to, a small collection of (Greek/Latin)

Put it together

Put it together: Greek chronika ('annals') comes from chronos, meaning 'time.' Chronicles are, at their root, a record built entirely around the passage of time — events set down in the order time actually delivered them.

Use the root in a new word: chronological

Use the root in a new word: chronological: The biography was arranged in chronological order, starting with her birth and ending with her final years.
